assessment: The source reports representative infrared f_1,0 values 5, 10, and 50 at fixed g_0=10^-56 and x_0,0=1, then explicitly gives alpha_Y = 2 x_0,0 f_1,0^2 g_0 / (1 + 6 x_0,0 f_1,0^2 g_0) at t=t_0. Every numerical constant and fixed parameter in the AST is present in the cited lines; f10 is the sole control, alpha_Y is the stated dimensionless Yukawa-strength readout, and the three-value Cartesian domain is source-reported. The exact analytic expression makes deterministic central-value evaluation appropriate.

controls.definition: Infrared initial value f_1(t_0) of the nonminimal coupling used in the scalar-tensor parametrization.
controls.name: f10

applicability.statement: Evaluate the relation at t=t_0 with fixed g_0=10^-56 and x_0,0=1 for the representative f_1,0 values reported in the table.

readouts.definition: Yukawa interaction strength alpha(t_0) obtained from the infrared scalar-tensor coupling data.
readouts.name: alpha_Y
